thread:
Anya: quick sync — ran the batcher+profiler pass for per-route token budgets. seeing p95 drift >120ms on auth-tier during KV cold windows. debating deficit queue vs strict cap, KV warmup signals, kernel fallback ordering. also noticed small latency regression after kernel selector tweak. :thinking:

Miguel: can you paste the perf numbers and profile traces? did you repro cache-warm vs cold?

Anya: minimal harness: 1000 requests, seq length skew to short tails, 3 GPUs. KV "cold" = TTL expired. p95:
```
warm cache p95: 85ms
cold cache p95: 180ms
after kernel-select v2: cold p95: 210ms
```
kernel selector seems to pick a slower matmul path for small batches when KV miss extends decode time.

Miguel: I instrumented queue depth + token allocation. deficit queue (borrow up to 20 tokens) ups throughput but increases p95 variance. strict cap cuts tails but wastes GPU. test patch:
```
batcher:
  queue_policy: deficit
  deficit_tokens: 20
  per_route_token_target:
    auth: {p95_target_ms: 120, base_tokens: 16, tier_multiplier: 1.5}
    default: {p95_target_ms: 200, base_tokens: 8}
kv:
  warmup_signal_ms: 5000
kernel:
  fallback_order: [fast_fp16, int8_fast, fp32_stable]
```
simulated misses: p95 -> 140ms but occasional cold storms spike tails.

perf-bot: regression alert: kernel-select v2 increased small-batch matmul median by 8% (detected 4h ago) :warning:

Sam: two ideas — (1) label requests with `cache_likely` from KV to let batcher preferentially batch hits, (2) when batch_size <=4 force int8_fast path to reduce jitter.

Kevin: agree. implement `cache_likely=true/false` in KV. batcher keeps two subqueues and only merges when latency budget allows. plan: canary 5% of auth routes for 24h.

Anya: making KV add label is doable. prefer deficit borrowing only within same route/tier to respect p95 SLOs.

Miguel: limit borrowing per route/tier and cap global borrowed tokens to avoid noisy neighbors. add a decay window to avoid sticky inflated budgets after storm.

Anya: new test config:
```
queue_policy: per_tier_deficit
deficit_per_tier: 12
borrow_decay_ms: 30000
prefer_cache_likely: true
kernel_switch: batch_size <= 4 -> int8_fast
canary: {percent: 5, routes: ["/auth/*"]}
```

Kevin: console must expose per-route borrowed_tokens and auto-rollback when canary p95 > target for 5m. ops needs automatic rollback hooks.

Sam: also add a small KV prefetch: when route sees >X misses in Y ms, prefetch next token chunk async to warm cache and avoid storms.

Anya: will run canary sim with these knobs and include perf flames + kernel decision traces in report. deploy in 6h, monitor 24h, rollback threshold p95 +30% over baseline.

Deploy-bot: deploy queued for eng-runtime/canary - change: batcher queue + kernel fallback - triggered by Anya - ETA 6h

Kevin: ping when canary live, I'll watch dashboards and alerts. :eyes:

Anya: thanks all, posting results after canary.
